author: Worthyreview
quote:
Worse than you could possibly imagine.
Games like GTA are of course held to a significantly higher standard than others and have their shortcomings amplified. 

Like many recent releases, to the misfortune legions of adoring fans, GTA is another franchise to have been neutered of the soul and fun that originally propelled it into ****.

Players can expect an almost familiar sandbox world that is extraordinarily beautiful but still somehow tragically dull and unexciting. 

The lack of excitement is noticeable quickly; mechanics of former entries in the franchise that once enhanced player experience are gone, simple activities such as stealing vehicles and driving around, are depreciated in favour of disappointing realism; immobilised cars and running out of fuel. Side quests which may have lured players into an crime laden adventure in past titles are replaced with DIY and running errands for an ungrateful girlfriend.

Performance is inexcusable. Attempting to use heavy explosive weapons, the use of which now must be carefully planned due to an inexplicably reduced weapon inventory, will grind your frame rate to sub-20. If you do managed to create some explosions , whether it is with a weapon, or a vehicle or plane? Prepare for the most deflating, cartoonish excuse for an explosion you can imagine. All that attention to detail in the scenery but you reused the explosion animation from GTA3? 

And perhaps most frustrating of all, invincible NPCs. Nothing saps the fun out of crime based sandbox quite like preventing the player from committing crimes they want to.

The direction Rockstar have taken with GTA 6 is depressing. Genuinely sad. It is not worth buying, not just because it is no fun, but because it will make you angry.
